text: HRW's World Report 2026 China chapter states that 'The Chinese government has since late 2016 committed a range of crimes against humanity in Xinjiang' and that 'Human rights defenders in China are frequently harassed, tortured, and imprisoned'; the M23 chapter conclusions elsewhere in the report note Rwanda's occupation of parts of eastern Congo. The Tour of Guangxi is owned and organised by the People's Government of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, a provincial-level Chinese government body.
short: China: crimes against humanity in Xinjiang; defenders harassed, tortured, imprisoned (HRW 2026)
